info.content: Opens when a product is added to the cart. Free shipping, set suggestions, order notes and the cart type (drawer or page) are in Theme settings > Cart. The drawer body uses the "Drawers and pop-ups" color scheme.

empty_collection.label: Empty cart button link
empty_collection.info: Pick a collection. Leave empty to link to all products.

info.content: Free shipping, set suggestions and order notes are in Theme settings > Cart.

empty_collection.label: Empty cart and "Continue shopping" link
empty_collection.info: Pick a collection. Leave empty to link to all products.

show_image.label: Show collection image
show_image.info: Uses the image of the collection (Products > Collections). A wide image works best.

show_description.label: Show collection description
show_description.info: Long descriptions are shortened, with a "Read more" button.

subnav_menu.label: Related collections menu
subnav_menu.info: Shown as chips under the heading. Leave it empty to build the chips from the main menu: the collection's own sub-categories, or else its sister categories, with an "All" chip first. Links to empty collections are left out.

enable_filtering.label: Enable filtering
enable_filtering.info: Choose the filters in the Shopify Search & Discovery app.

option_style.label: Size filter style
option_style.info: Applies to product option filters, such as size.

enable_filtering.label: Enable filtering
enable_filtering.info: Choose the filters in the Shopify Search & Discovery app. Filters show only for product results.

option_style.label: Size filter style
option_style.info: Applies to product option filters, such as size.

suggestions_menu.label: Suggestions menu
suggestions_menu.info: Shown as chips before a search and when a search has no results. Link popular searches or collections.

collections.info: Leave empty to show all collections.

sort.label: Order
sort.info: Applies when showing all collections. A to Z shows every collection across pages; other orders show up to 50.

show_language_selector.label: Show language selector
show_language_selector.info: Shown when the store has more than one published language.

show_social.label: Show social media links
show_social.info: Links come from Theme settings > Social media and Business details.

accessibility_page.label: Accessibility statement page
accessibility_page.info: Linked at the bottom of every page. Israeli law (IS 5568) requires an accessibility statement.

business_info.content: The business name, business ID and address at the bottom come from Theme settings > Business details.

logo_info.content: The logo comes from Theme settings > Brand.

show_heading.label: Show heading
show_heading.info: When hidden, screen readers still announce it.

heading.info: Leave empty to show the menu's own title, translated with the menu.

info.content: Phone, email and WhatsApp come from Theme settings > Business details.
Subscribers are added to Customers with the "newsletter" tag and consent to email marketing.

show_title.label: Show page title
show_title.info: When hidden, screen readers and search engines still get it.

show_card.label: Show contact card
show_card.info: WhatsApp, phone and email come from Theme settings > Business details.

heading_tag.info: Use H1 when this is the main section of the page, as on the team orders page.

whatsapp_label.label: WhatsApp button label
whatsapp_label.info: The WhatsApp number comes from Theme settings > Business details. Leave empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.

show_form.label: Show quote request form
show_form.info: Requests arrive at the store's email address, like contact form messages.

preset.label: Ready-made text
preset.info: Already translated into every store language. A title and text of your own replace it.

show_heading.label: Show heading
show_heading.info: Hide it when the page title already says the same.

enable_schema.label: Add FAQ structured data for search engines
enable_schema.info: Use it on one page only, where the questions are the main content.

preset.label: Ready-made text
preset.info: Already translated into every store language. A question and answer of your own replace it.

show_heading.label: Show heading
show_heading.info: Hide it when the page title already says it, as on the size guide page.

adult_chart.label: Adult size chart
adult_chart.info: A "Size chart" entry from Content > Metaobjects. Without one, the tab says that each product's chart is on its product page.

kids_chart.label: Kids' size chart
kids_chart.info: A "Size chart" entry for kids. Without one, the tab shows a short note on kids' sizes. How to measure is shown below the tabs either way.

show_help.label: Show WhatsApp help
show_help.info: Needs a WhatsApp number in Theme settings > Business details.

info.content: Shows the details from Theme settings > Business details. Only the details you filled in appear.

show_channels.label: Show phone, email and WhatsApp
show_channels.info: Turn off where a contact card already shows them, for example on the contact page.

text.info: Shown when the password page message in Online Store > Preferences is empty. Leave empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.

show_signup.label: Show email sign-up
show_signup.info: Sign-ups are saved as customers tagged "prospect" and "password page".

autorotate.label: Rotate messages automatically
autorotate.info: Only when there is more than one message. Rotation pauses while visitors hover over or focus the bar, and they can stop it with the pause button. It never starts for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

default_text.content: The default message follows "Free shipping from" in Theme settings > Cart: at 0 it says shipping is free on every order, above 0 it gives the amount, and when the field is empty it shows only the delivery time (within 10 business days).

info.content: The logo is set in Theme settings > Brand, and the language switcher shows every language published in Settings > Languages.

menu.info: A link with sub-links opens a mega menu on desktop, with an image for each sub-category (up to 8 third-level links under it, then "View all") and products from the category. On mobile each level opens its own panel with the full list. Up to 3 levels.

hide_empty_collections.label: Hide empty categories
hide_empty_collections.info: Links to a category with no products in the online store are left out of the menu, the mega menu and the mobile menu. Draft products and products that are not on the Online Store sales channel don't count. The theme editor always shows the whole menu.

show_featured_products.label: Show products in the mega menu
show_featured_products.info: The category's first 3 products, in its own sort order.

info.content: Shows in the mega menu of the top-level link that leads to the category you choose, in place of the products.

collection.label: Category of the menu link
collection.info: Choose the category that the top-level menu link leads to, for example Football jerseys.

heading.info: First line. Leave both heading lines empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.

heading_highlight.label: Highlighted line
heading_highlight.info: Second line, in the accent color.

button_link.info: Leave empty to link to the collection whose URL ends in /collections/football, or to all products until it exists.

secondary_button_link.info: Leave empty to link to the collection whose URL ends in /collections/basketball, or to all products until it exists.

season.label: Outlined text behind the images
season.info: For example the season, 26/27. Leave empty to hide it.

image_1.label: Product image 1
image_1.info: A product photo with a transparent background (PNG), about 1000 × 1000 px. Until you add one, two drawn kits are shown on the circle.

image.info: A landscape photo, at least 2000 px wide.

overlay_opacity.label: Overlay strength
overlay_opacity.info: Shades the photo behind the text so it stays readable.

image_ltr.label: Image for left-to-right languages (English)
image_ltr.info: Optional. A desktop photo with the people on the right, since the text sits on the left in English. When set, mirroring is off.

mirror_ltr.label: Mirror the photo in left-to-right languages
mirror_ltr.info: Photos are composed for Hebrew: people on the left, text on the right. In English the text moves to the left, and mirroring keeps the people on the other side. Don't use it for photos with text or logos.

info.content: Up to 4 benefits. A benefit with empty text uses the default text for its position (delivery, returns, stock in Israel, secure payment), already translated into every store language.

text.info: Leave empty to use the default text for this position.

collection.info: The link shows the collection's name, translated with the collection.

label.label: Label
label.info: Leave empty to use the collection's name.

link.info: Optional. Use it to link somewhere other than the collection.

featured.label: Highlight
featured.info: Shows this link in inverted colors.

heading.info: Leave empty to use the collection's name, which is translated with the collection.

audience.label: Show
audience.info: Adults and kids are told apart by the product tag audience:kids.

one_per_team.label: One product per team
one_per_team.info: Shows only the first product of each team, so the row shows more teams.

mobile_scroller.label: Swipe on mobile
mobile_scroller.info: Shows the products in one row that customers swipe through, instead of a grid.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: A scrolling row shows the products in one row that scrolls sideways, with arrows on desktop.

button_link.info: The link under the sets. Leave empty to link to all products.

info.content: A jersey and the shorts of the same team, bought together. With more than one set, team tabs switch between them; a tab takes the name of the jersey's team category. A set whose jersey or shorts is sold out is hidden.

image.info: A product photo or a lifestyle photo. Without an image, a jersey illustration is shown.

options.contain: Fit (the whole product on a light background)
options.cover: Fill (crops the photo to fill the area)

button_link.info: Leave empty to link to all products.
Leave empty to link to the collection whose URL ends in /collections/kids, or to all products until it exists.

secondary_link.label: Size guide link
secondary_link.info: Leave empty to open the kids' table on the page whose URL ends in /pages/size-guide. If that page doesn't exist, the link is hidden.

size_code.label: Size
size_code.info: As the kids products name it, for example 16. The age and height below show under it.

title.label: Age
title.info: The ages this size fits, for example 2-3. Without a size, the age becomes the tile's main label and the word "years" is added.

height_cm.label: Height (cm)
height_cm.info: The child's height for this size, a number or a range such as 95-105. Leave empty to hide it.

button_link.info: Leave empty to open a WhatsApp chat with the number in Theme settings > Business details. If both are empty, the button is hidden.
The button is shown only when it has a link.

image.info: Portrait photo (4:5). Without one, the collection's image shows.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: A collection without products isn't shown on the storefront.

page.label: Page
page.info: Instead of a collection, e.g. team orders. The title comes from the page's title.

title.label: Title
title.info: Leave empty to use the collection's or page's title.

link.label: Other link
link.info: Only when no collection or page is chosen.

button_link.info: Leave empty to link to all products.

image.label: Desktop image
image.info: A wide, short photo, at least 3000 px wide (4:1). People on the left; the text sits on the right.

image_mobile.info: Portrait photo (4:5). Without one, the desktop photo is cropped.

copy.label: Ready-made text
copy.info: Text already translated into every store language. Anything you type in the fields below replaces it.

settings.sticky_info: Keep product details in view while scrolling (desktop)
settings.media_badge_text_info: Short text shown on the images of every product page. Leave empty for no badge.
settings.eyebrow_info: Shows the team and league from the product's custom data (metafields sportwear.team and sportwear.leagues). Hidden when both are empty.
settings.audience_info: Appears only when the product is linked to its adults or kids version (metafield sportwear.counterpart).
settings.low_stock_threshold_info: Shown when the selected size has this many items or fewer in stock. Based on your real inventory.
settings.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Apple Pay, Google Pay and other express options, as set up in your payment settings.
settings.show_free_shipping_info: Follows "Free shipping from" in Theme settings > Cart: "Free shipping on every order" at 0, the amount above 0. Hidden when that field is empty.
settings.complete_set_info: Shows the products linked in the product's metafield sportwear.complements. Hidden when there are none or they are sold out.
settings.show_set_note_info: Shown when the two items together reach the free shipping amount from Theme settings > Cart. Never shown when every order ships free (0).
settings.collapsible_info: Leave the heading and content empty to show the default shipping and returns text.
settings.page_info: Shows the content of this page instead of the text above.
settings.size_table_info: Uses the product's size chart (metafield sportwear.size_chart). Without one, kids products show sizes by height and adult products show how to measure.
settings.show_sticky_buy_info: Appears at the bottom of the screen once the add to cart button has scrolled out of view (on desktop, once the product details have). Customers can choose their size in it.
settings.show_payment_icons: Show payment methods under the buttons
settings.show_whatsapp_info: Shown when a WhatsApp number is set in Theme settings > Business details.

settings.intent_info: Complementary products are chosen in the Search & Discovery app. The section stays hidden when there is nothing to recommend.

logo.label: Logo
logo.info: Replaces the built-in SW mark and the text logo. Leave empty to use them.

logo_style.label: Logo style
logo_style.info: Used when no logo image is uploaded.

accent.label: Brand accent
accent.info: Used for badges, the text logo and highlights. If you change it, update the color schemes that use it too.

share_image.label: Social sharing image
share_image.info: Shown when a page without its own image is shared. 1200 × 628 px recommended.

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.info: Accent used for selected states and highlights

background_gradient.label: Background gradient
background_gradient.info: Optional. Replaces the background color when set.

fonts_info.content: The theme uses its own fonts for Hebrew, English and Arabic.

card_image_fit.label: Image fit
card_image_fit.info: "Fit" shows the whole product on a light background. "Fill" crops to fill the tile.

card_new_tag.label: Tag for the "New" badge
card_new_tag.info: Products with this tag get the "New" badge.

free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping from (₪)
free_shipping_threshold.info: Controls every free-shipping message (announcement bar, trust badges, product page, cart, FAQ). 0 = free shipping on every order: the cart shows a short line instead of the progress bar. Above 0 = free shipping from that amount, with the progress bar. Empty = no free-shipping messages. Shown to visitors in Israel only; must match Settings > Shipping.

cart_show_upsell.label: Suggest set items in the cart

info.content: Shown in the footer, on the contact page and in the accessibility statement. Israeli law requires sellers to publish these details.

settings.heading: Heading
settings.default_text_info: Leave empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.
